body:
maria_cs: Heads-up - NordWind go-live tomorrow. Quick checklist for the customer-facing runbook: prefill tokens, streaming enabled, keep batching low for interactive queries. I'm dropping the checklist below.

jon_eng: thanks. can you paste the exact flags we should set in the UI?

maria_cs: sure — Customer Console settings: `prefetch=true`, `batching.max_tokens=256`, `batching.window_ms=20`, `streaming.enabled=true`. Also set `cache.scope=tenant` and `cache.ttl=300s`.

sam_sre: for surge-proofing, add warm pools: `min_instances=2`, `burst_capacity=3`, metrics hook to `cs.telemetry.prefill_attempts`.

lisa_pm: important for renewal: capture "time-to-first-response" and "avg tokens per session" in the health card. If TTFB > 300ms twice in 1h -> flag renewal risk.

maria_cs: here's a short customer-facing blurb we can send in onboarding emails: "We'll prefill your most common prompts to reduce cold-token latency. You can opt out at any time."

jon_eng: minor note — if customer is using long prefix prompts (>1k tokens) we should auto-switch to `large-seq` variant to avoid OOMs.

sam_sre: obs: add a trace link param `?prefill_id=` so we can correlate prefill attempts with traces.

deploy-bot: live rollout scheduled 08:00 UTC. Canary 5% -> 20% -> 100% over 30m.

maria_cs: field ops checklist for tomorrow's 09:30 call with NordWind: 1) Confirm cache.prefill enabled 2) Validate warm-pool active 3) Run scripted sample (attached) 4) Capture feedback in the Notion board

lisa_pm: attached sample script (paste):
```
# sample probe
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/generate \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
 -d '{"prompt":"Hello","stream":true}'
```

jon_eng: If they report flaky streaming, have them enable `streaming.fallback_to_polling=true` while we triage.

maria_cs: renewal trigger logic proposed:
- health_score drops by 12% month-over-month
- TTFB > 300ms for 3 consecutive windows
- Customer reports repeated quality regressions on our eval set
If any 2 of 3 -> PM outreach + field CTO call.

sam_sre: also add alert: `prefill_fail_rate > 5%` across tenant -> page oncall.

maria_cs: I'll consolidate into the runbook and email the NordWind onboarding packet after the call. tagging @jon_eng @sam_sre for final review :+1:

jon_eng: ack. quick Q: where do we store the feedback artifacts? Notion board link?

maria_cs: Notion: https://redwood.in/notion/cs-prefill-feedback (please add a row with `customer,note,timestamp,trace_link`)

lisa_pm: one last note: capture consent checkbox language in the asset; legal prefers "opt-in" phrasing for prefill autoload.

maria_cs: got it. I'll update and push by EOD.
